# Taiwan

> [!summary] Data available
> Taiwan has a BLEnD culture, 28 WorldCuisines dishes and good compound-side data (NPASS, Exposome-Explorer), but no recipes or FCT. Start with [[BLEnD]] (Mandarin_Taiwan) and [[WorldCuisines]] for food and [[Exposome-Explorer]] / [[CMAUP]] for compounds; TCM sources for China apply largely.

## Foods & dishes
[[BLEnD]] 105 food questions (Mandarin_Taiwan), 465 answer clusters; [[WorldCuisines]] 28 dishes (11 Taiwan-only); [[World Wide Dishes]] 1. No recipes with amounts.

## Ingredients & food composition
No FCT, processed or in the Backlog.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
[[CMAUP]] 234 plants; [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 7 records; [[NPASS]] 516 pairs; [[Exposome-Explorer]] 381 rows; [[HERB]] 90 meta-analyses from Taiwan. TCM is shared with [[China]] ([[SymMap]], [[HERB]], [[TM-MC]]). Global resources without country labels (FooDB, SpiceRx, FlavorDB2, Phenol-Explorer, CTD, HMDB, FoodAtlas, FooDrugs) apply via [[Global]].

## Gaps
No recipes, no Taiwanese FCT in the vault or Backlog.
